notes.title: Halloween Update!
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44799786/54e282be55d44e4eaaf7418fb6a4d50ca627da17.png

Happy Halloween!

This update adds a new difficulty mode to the campaign and a new Halloween themed character.


Campaign changes

- Small changes to the tutorial level
- 24 new levels
- Difficulty options added to the campaign level selection screen

The campaign can now be played in either "Easy" or "Hard" difficulties.
The Hard difficulty consists of the previously existing levels.
The new Easy difficulty consists of the 24 newly added levels. These offer a more relaxed experience to the game.
Playing in either difficulty allows you to proceed in the campaign. You can replay previously completed levels in either difficulty from the level selection screen.


Endless and Versus

The new campaign levels were also added to these modes.


Level Search

You can find all campaign levels using the level search screen.
They will have the names SAMUZA 1-2 to 5-5 followed with (Easy) or (Hard).
You can also easily find the campaign levels by using the [OFFICIAL] option on the [Search By] dropdown.

notes.title: Update Notes for 03/15
notes.notes:
New Blocks
This update adds a few blocks that complement the existing slimmer road variations.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44799786/23215adc85478d23370beea7764bc22be22e92a7.png
Added three new road blocks shaped like the letters X, Y and reversed Y.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44799786/57b8ecd4f25b88e03cbda2df363148f627a81af0.png
Added two new slimmer variations for both left and right corners.


New Levels
Added 5 levels to showcase the new blocks.
Although not part of the campaign, these will show up on the Endless and 2P Versus modes.
You can also find them in the search screens with the names:
March 15 Showcase 1
March 15 Showcase 2
March 15 Showcase 3
March 15 Showcase 4
March 15 Showcase 5


Fixes
Creator Mode:
fixed - bug with map and layout selection when using a gamepad
fixed - moving out of text fields when pressing the letter keys used for UI navigation

Gameplay:
fixed - character and camera facing direction when reseting to round block checkpoints
fixed - incorrect collision with the ground on the first map of the campaign

notes.title: Update Notes for 02/22

You can find them in the Video tab on the Settings menu.

notes.title: SAMUZA Release!
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44799786/8fa804220c4bbcd71a49694c606e6005fe2868cc.png

Hi everyone,

SAMUZA has just released!
For now, we will be focusing in fixing small stuff and improving the game experience overall.
More important fixes will have a post here in the community area.
